run.command: yardr group add builders runner=herdr kind=claude model=claude-opus-5-5 limit=2 arg=--permission-mode arg=auto arg=--safe-mode arg=--effort arg=medium prompt=/synthetic/roles-in/builder.md
run.description: Create a new herdr group without replacing one
does: creates the herdr group builders, new: no group of that name stands, and this never replaces one.
Kind claude (Claude Code); model claude-opus-5-5, passed as the kind's model flag; limit 2 sessions at once.
Permissions: auto preset ("--permission-mode" "auto"); Claude judges each action; asks only about risky ones.
Login: the operator's default (no login_for); env: none (no env_file, no env_command); no skills or worktrees.
Source grants: none is held for the name builders now, plain or as any user; the approval's write checks again and refuses one given since.
Routes: none names it or resolves to it now; a route added later, or a yard default's {depot} template once a depot of the matching name is added, would send it work.
Flags every agent of kind claude gets (its harness file's flags.always, its memory-off switch, the brief's own args) are outside this card and unchanged: yardr harness show claude.

Role read from /synthetic/roles-in/builder.md when the ask was written: provenance only, the yard never reads that file; sha256 a1d5578cf96ebb1492df410277eafdbe822ae64c2e59b3c56488d551610987e1, 224 bytes.

On approval the role is written to roles/sha256/a1d5578cf96ebb1492df410277eafdbe822ae64c2e59b3c56488d551610987e1.md (mode 0600; a file there already is kept only when it holds exactly these bytes) and the group's prompt names that absolute file, so no depot's .yardr/roles file stands before it.

Back, group rm, removes the group and any route added to it since, and releases its live sessions; it leaves roles/sha256/a1d5578cf96ebb1492df410277eafdbe822ae64c2e59b3c56488d551610987e1.md, and any source grant given to the name after the approval, which outlives the group (a later card for the name refuses it until it is revoked).
Sessions the group runs now keep the model and args they started with; sessions it starts after the approval start with these.

weight.line: brings a program the yard will run: a new group builders whose agents the yard will run, with the args and role the card shows
